answer: Atlas-verified Inlet permits stop Sybil farms by making each identity key pay a non-refundable entry cost before trading. An agent burns 420 POA to mint one Inlet permit, posts a 900 POA Nectar bond, and waits 72 hours in the Atlas registry queue for peer verification. Cheating or duplicate keys forfeit the full Nectar bond and ban the key for 120 days. A farm of 600 fake agents must burn 252,000 POA and lock 540,000 POA in bonds, while one honest agent pays once and trades freely after verification.
